Hi James,

Thank you for your interest in hosting a dinner with us at Apolonia! Our
Private Dining Room is available on Tuesday, March 18th. Below is all of
the information on the space with sample menus, as well as pictures of the
space attached.

The space echoes the casual, modern, and bright atmosphere of the main
dining room and is located in an intimate room on the East side of the
restaurant. The space can accommodate parties of up to 24 people. Multiple
table configurations are available.

We offer two menus at two different price points; both are designed to
showcase the best of our seasonally-changing menu. Dishes are served
family-style and will be presented over multiple consecutive courses.

Our signature Chef’s menu is $85 per person and can be customized to
accommodate most allergies, dietary restrictions, or special requests.

Our Experience menu is $110 per person and features rotating large format
dishes, such as octopus,  premium desserts, and option of upgrading the
steak cut.

We also offer wine pairings, starting at $69 per person pairing with
standard selections, and a $89 per person pairing with reserve selections,
both specially curated by our sommelier. Should you forgo this option, your
party can order drinks a la carte from your server.

To reserve the Private Dining Space at Apolonia requires a $170 room fee,
and we will ask for a $150 deposit which goes toward a food & beverage
minimum of $2k (minimums are not inclusive of tax, added gratuity and room
fee). The space is yours for 3 hours and can be reserved as early as 5:00
pm Monday - Sunday for dinner, 11:30 am Monday - Friday for lunch, and
10:30 am Saturday & Sunday for brunch.

If you are interested in moving forward with this date, please let me know
and I would be happy to place the date on a tentative hold as well as draft
a contract for your review. Please do not hesitate to reach out with any
questions on the above!

subject: Re: Encord Picing
text:
Hi Steffan,

Thanks for following up!

As discussed, we’re starting small for now—large-scale curation is
currently out of scope. Over the next six months, we’re focused on targeted
annotation projects and iterating on our existing dataset.

However, beyond that, we will consider extending our usage, and I believe
the ROI in starting large scale curation work on Encord will be much
clearer at that stage. Especially if we’re already integrated with your
platform and using it for our baseline data work.And looking beyond a
one-year horizon, we expect to scale significantly and raise our Series A.
At that point, both our usage and budget will expand considerably.

I appreciate your flexibility and understand that working within our budget
constraints might be a stretch. That said, one of the challenges we face is
that we’re currently paying $15K per year with V7, which makes it difficult
to justify a significant price hike, even if we recognize that Encord is a
stronger platform with better support. Additionally, we’re in discussions
with Dataloop, which we currently prefer over V7, and it looks like they
may be able to meet our needs at around $20K.

We’d love to explore options that align with our current phase while
keeping the door open for a long-term collaboration. Let me know what could
be possible.

Best,

Mate
